fields.why: Race/ethnicity (7 groups) and urban-rural status (6 groups) have outcomes per group with 'higher than other groups' claims under blanket t-/z-tests; age (3 groups) has per-group values in Table 1.
Sex is two groups; state and Census region are geography, not SPDs. The three SPDs with 3+ groups compared are age, race/ethnicity and rurality.

Race and rurality claims ('higher among White and AI/AN than other groups'; 'noncore higher than all others except small metros') rest on blanket two-sample t-/z-tests: per-group vs referent only. Age groups are only shown in Table 1 with no claim, so side by side; the mechanical flag is a false alarm because the CI-overlap rule backs no age claim.
